title: A same-universe representative extension of a Zariski torsor
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $G$ be an abelian sheaf on its small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site], and let $T$ be a $G$-torsor [def-sc-gm-torsor]. There exists a short exact sequence $0\to G\xrightarrow{\iota}E\xrightarrow{p}\mathbf Z_X\to0$ of abelian sheaves [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] such that $T$ is isomorphic, equivariantly for the $G$ action, to the sheaf of local lifts of the global section $1$ through $p$. Here $X$, the values of $G$, and the values of $E$ are in the same universe $u$. No cohomology-class identity is asserted.

source.place: Lemma 02FQ (cohomology-lemma-torsors-h1), first construction by pushout of the free abelian sheaf; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02FQ

proof.text: Use the explicitly constructed free abelian relation pushout E, its coefficient inclusion i, its degree projection p, and their proved short exactness. This uses the same universe u as X and G.

Map each torsor section t to its free generator in E. Naturality follows from the unit of sheafification and the pushout inclusion. The sheafified augmentation gives degree one. Evaluate pushout.condition on (t,g + t), use toSheafify_naturality and toSheafify_sheafifyLift, and use Torsor.sub_vadd_eq: the relation is [g + t]-[t]=i(g). This proves equivariance of the map into the lifting torsor.

Apply the already proved Torsor.Iso.ofHom to this natural equivariant map between T and the lifting torsor. An equivariant map between torsors is locally bijective by simple transitivity and local nonemptiness, hence an isomorphism of sheaves. Package E,i,p,the zero-composition equality, short exactness and this isomorphism into the required existential.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 02FQ, first construction; fully proved pair-relation presentation and cokernel argument implementing the free-abelian pushout construction
